extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: retro espresso machine, approx. 24 x 30 x 34 cm
extras.notes: front faces -Y; sky-blue housing, steel brew group and drip tray, espresso cup with crema on a saucer, steam wand (+X), pressure gauge with mint zone and needle (no digits), steam dial, power button and indicator light, steel cup warmer on top; 'coffee-machine_portafilter' is a separate object with its origin on the brew-group axis (rotate around local Z to unlock, then lower along -Z); no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
